optimizations.title: IPv4 forwarding is enabled
optimizations.detail: ip_forward=1 exposes the host as a router; only keep it on if network features need it.

optimizations.title: Swappiness above recommended range
optimizations.detail: vm.swappiness is 60. Values 10-30 are typical for database and web workloads.

optimizations.title: Transparent Huge Pages set to always
optimizations.detail: THP in 'always' mode can cause latency spikes on database and virtualized workloads.
